description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mirigama, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510200 (231016)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed information about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal interests. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
